## Goal
Introduce source-specific transition value classes and require normal, definition lifecycle, and explicit recovery callers to use the correct policy before one atomic step commit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R3 normal set-step accepts only current in_progress→done|skipped and rejects every listed invalid matrix entry without mutation.
- R4 NormalStepTransition, DefinitionLifecycleTransition, and ExplicitRecoveryTransition enforce constructor and provenance invariants.
- R5 FlowStore performs one status/timestamp/promotion write, post-commit effects run once, terminal retry has no duplicate, and c9de behavior is unchanged.
- R8/R9 lifecycle/recovery ownership and migration parity are exercised by spec-local and focused shared tests.
